Olivia (People Ops): Quick coordination for Kayla Rivera's first day on Tue — we need I-9 verification, background check follow-up, badge + laptop pickup. Who can support on-site? :wave:
Maria (ENG - Hiring): I'll be there first hour. If she doesn't have passport on arrival, what's our fallback for I-9? :thinking:
Olivia (People Ops): We can do remote I-9 within 3 days via verifier, but preferred is in-person same-day. Acceptable docs: passport OR driver's license + Social Security card. If delayed, mark status as 'I-9 pending' in HRIS and escalate to payroll so there's no delay in benefits enrollment. :clipboard:
Devon (IT): I'll reserve the lobby kiosk 09:00-10:00. Planning imaging slot 09:15-09:45. Need final email to pre-create account and request MDM token.
Olivia (People Ops): Kayla's email is kayla.rivera@redwood.ai — sending account request now. Also sending GoodHire link — background check must be completed by EOD Mon per hiring checklist.
Devon (IT): Sent kiosk invite to kayla.rivera@redwood.ai and created a calendar event: "Kiosk imaging — Kayla R" 09:15-09:45. Will label laptop: "Kayla R" for reception.
Jose (Security): Badge provisioning backlog is heavier this week. I can do an express badge if People Ops confirms start date and job code. Olivia, can you open a helpdesk ticket with "badge expedite"? I'll attach the employee photo once ticket is in.
Olivia (People Ops): Done — ticket IN-4587 created and flagged for expedite. Also arranging shuttle pickup for anyone coming from the satellite office at 08:40 (3rd Ave stop). :bus:
hr-bot: GoodHire background check status: link sent to kayla.rivera@redwood.ai — status: pending. Reminder scheduled in 12 hours.
Maria (ENG - Hiring): Benefits walk-through is 10:30 in Conf B. New hire needs to e-sign W-4 + direct deposit before payroll cutoff (Fri 17:00). Please remind them to bring bank routing/account number if not done in advance.
Devon (IT): Laptop: MacBook Pro 14" reserved. Will leave at reception with a sticker "Kayla R" and include power adapter & protective sleeve. I'll bring a spare USB-C hub in case of peripheral needs.
Olivia (People Ops): Day-1 checklist I'll email to Kayla: 1) Bring I-9 docs 2) Complete GoodHire link 3) E-sign W-4 & DD 4) Badge pickup at reception (show ID) 5) Laptop pickup & MDM enrollment 6) Benefits session 10:30. I'll include a map to kiosk and shuttle info.
Devon (IT): If she can't make it in person, I have a verifier license for a 15:00 remote I-9 Zoom slot. Remote rules: show original documents on camera and mail/scan copies within 3 business days.
Olivia (People Ops): Perfect — we'll offer the 15:00 remote slot if needed and note it in the calendar invite. Also tracking: GoodHire must be green before badge is issued per Security policy.
Maria (ENG - Hiring): Thanks everyone. I'll meet Kayla at reception at 09:10 and do the team intro at 11:00.
Olivia (People Ops): Thanks all — Kayla, welcome! :tada: We'll follow up with the calendar invite and email with links/instructions."
